paragraphs.text: Xining Caojiabao International Airport (XNN/ZLXN) serves as a key air gateway for Haidong (Huzhu Tu Autonomous County), CN, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 11/29: 3800 m (12467 ft) asphalt.

Ground transportation options connecting Xining Caojiabao International Airport with central Haidong (Huzhu Tu Autonomous County) include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from XNN should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Xining Caojiabao International Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Xining Caojiabao International Airport is XNN and the ICAO code is ZLXN.

faqs.q: Which city does XNN airport serve?
faqs.a: Xining Caojiabao International Airport (XNN) serves Haidong (Huzhu Tu Autonomous County), CN.
